result.title: Iris-Z: Scaling One Generative Model Past Specialist Geometry Models
result.comment: 14 pages, 9 figures, 6 tables. Code and models: https://github.com/speridlabs/iris-z-sdk
result.summary: Language moved from many task-specific models to one unified model: a single generative model with a single generative training task that handles all of them within the same backbone, and keeps improving with data, parameters and compute. We believe the bitter lesson applies just as much to computer vision, 3D and spatial understanding, in the end to visual intelligence: the effort should go into general architectures that solve all these tasks in a unified way, and into scaling them, rather than into task-specific designs. We test this on monocular geometry, a task that has belonged to specialised architectures for years. Iris-Z is a general image generator that produces appearance and geometry together. A single backbone denoises, reasons about and understands the image and its depth at the same time, and one set of weights generates images with their depth, estimates depth from photographs and paints images onto a given depth. At enough scale it surpasses state-of-the-art specialists on established depth benchmarks while keeping the generative abilities of the backbone it started from without specialized layers. We release two models for the community.

AI.brief_summary: Iris-Z 提出用单一生成骨干同时生成图像外观与深度，兼做单目深度估计和以深度为条件的图像生成，并在规模扩大后超过专用几何模型。
AI.relevance_reason: 该工作属于统一图像/几何生成与深度预测的专用模型替代，未涉及 latent 推理状态、证据获取、停止决策或推理期视觉信息使用，与 LVR 主线缺少可核查的具体联系。
